context:
North Star: characterize which bounded state observables are actually sufficient for correct routing/behavior under fixed resources, using frozen diagnostic partitions and no post-result fitting.

Sealed public result: UP-256C-current-state-component-sufficiency qualified as BOTH_INDIVIDUALLY_SUFFICIENT. Across the same 64 paired initial states, STATIC9 had 17 groups with 4 mixed groups and up to 3 classes per group. STATIC9_EVENTS produced 25 groups with 0 mixed groups. STATIC9_SIGNATURES independently produced 25 groups with 0 mixed groups. Their joint partition also produced 25 groups with 0 mixed groups. No intervention, classifier training, adaptive feature selection, or live activation was used.

Interpretation boundary: both current event_present and current_signature are individually sufficient on this paired substrate, but this does not establish whether they encode the same equivalence relation, whether one is a deterministic function of the other, or whether either remains sufficient under a controlled substrate expansion.

Select one next experiment with maximal information value. Prefer a frozen observational or single-factor perturbation test that discriminates redundancy/equivalence from two distinct sufficient summaries before expanding model capacity. Do not fit a classifier or tune after results. Provide: question, hypothesis, exact frozen sample/substrate, intervention if any, controls, primary statistics, preregistered classifications, and the expected scientific update for each outcome.
